instrument: RCM Hill, LLC v. Hill County, Texas (42 U.S.C. 1983)
summary: A data center developer sued Hill County and individual county officials under 42 U.S.C. 1983 in May 2026 over a county moratorium; the case was dismissed with prejudice on July 9, 2026 without a determination that the officials were personally liable.

source.citation: As described in the Pulaski County veto letter, Sept 25, 2026
